## User story

**As a** city planner,
**I want** a readable passive cooling blueprint and recent scan history,
**so that** I can compare zones and select practical cooling interventions.

Traceability: **STORY-019 → EPIC-007 → FR-22** in [requirements](../../../agile/requirements.md); FR-6, FR-18, NFR-2 and NFR-8 also apply.

## Acceptance criteria

**AC1 — Surface chart**
Given a valid surface breakdown,
when the blueprint renders,
then a bar or donut chart shows the returned percentages with asphalt dark grey, dark roof near-black, concrete light grey and green canopy green.

**AC2 — Cooling recommendations**
Given a valid passive cooling plan,
when the blueprint renders,
then corridor orientation is prominent, coating area is shown in m², projected surface-temperature drop is shown in °C, and each micro-canopy intervention appears as a checklist item.

**AC3 — Recent scans**
Given successful `/api/scans` responses containing reports or an empty list,
when I refresh history,
then the dashboard shows the returned reports in a readable newest-first table or a clear empty state without inventing missing report fields.

## Tasks

- [x] Render the four surface percentages as metrics
- [x] Display corridor orientation, coating area, projected temperature drop and intervention text
- [x] Request recent audits on refresh and show an empty-history message
- [ ] Add the surface chart with fixed material colours
- [ ] Use m² consistently and present interventions as a checklist
- [ ] Present returned recent reports as a table using the configured API endpoint
- [ ] Remove deleted fields from history in coordination with STORY-018 and STORY-020
- [ ] Test chart data, unit labels, safe API text and empty history with mocked HTTP

## Current state

[frontend/app.py](../../../frontend/app.py) displays four percentage metrics rather than a chart. It shows the returned corridor, coating area labelled `sq. meters`, projected drop in °C and bullet-style intervention text; there is no intervention checklist. History calls a hardcoded `/api/scans?limit=5` URL, reads the `scans` wrapper, displays expanders rather than a table and handles an empty list.

The history view also reads deleted `surface_temp_estimate_c` and `requires_emergency_alert`; those real defects are owned by STORY-018 and STORY-020 and require orchestrator filing, not new IDs in these documents. Missing plan fields currently render `None` values rather than a useful gap state; STORY-021 owns that degraded experience. No cloud access, HVI computation or unit conversion happens in the UI.

## Test cases

| Test                                                   | Asserts                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `test_surface_chart_preserves_percentages_and_colours` | Chart uses returned values and the fixed four material colours                           |
| `test_blueprint_displays_all_metric_recommendations`   | Corridor, m² coating, °C drop and every checklist item render                            |
| `test_recent_scans_table_and_empty_state`              | Mocked history renders newest-first rows or a clear empty message without deleted fields |

## Definition of done

The three AppTest cases pass with mocked API responses, all blueprint sections render current fields in metric units, recent scans are readable, and the offline suite remains green without coverage regression.
